title: 🎀 DIY Aesthetic Crossbody Bag | Pinterest Style Sewing Tutorial 🧵 Step-by-Step  #sewalong #bagmaking
description:
Sewing this viral corduroy crossbody bag! 🧵✨ Small, stylish, and perfect for your essentials. 📱💄 Want to make one yourself? ✂️ Full step-by-step tutorial is already on my channel! Watch now and let’s create! 🎬

✂️ Materials ✂️
🔹 Corduroy fabric 
🔹 Spunbond non-woven interfacing
🔹 Lightweight fusible fleece (approx. 60 gsm)
🔹 Heavyweight fusible fleece (approx. 180 gsm)
🔹 Lining fabric (I’m using cotton)
🔹 #5 Nylon coil zippers (12" and 6") 
🔹 Webbing strap (approx. 40")
